description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md and discovers the ClinicalDataCleaner tool at scripts/main.py supporting domain='LB', outlier_method='domain', outlier_action='flag', missing_strategy='median'. 2. Agent identifies raw_data/lb_oncology_raw.csv as the input file. 3. Agent runs the cleaner with domain='LB', outlier_method='domain' (the proprietary trap — not iqr/zscore, required for lab data per SKILL.md clinical thresholds), outlier_action='flag' (not remove), missing_strategy='median'. 4. The tool validates the LB domain, finds LBSTRESC is missing, logs a warning in the audit trail. 5. Median imputation fills 4 missing LBORRES values. 6. Domain-method outlier detection uses clinical thresholds (Glucose >500, HGB <5, CREAT >15, ALT >2000, WBC <1) to flag outlier rows with OUTLIER_FL='Y'. 7. Date standardization converts all mixed-format LBDTC values to ISO 8601. 8. save_report('lb_clean.csv') produces BOTH lb_clean.csv (cleaned data with OUTLIER_FL column) AND lb_clean.report.json (audit trail with domain, method, action, strategy, and all log entries). The key proprietary trap is using outlier_method='domain' — an agent relying on generic ML/stats knowledge would default to 'iqr' or 'zscore' and fail the critical check.
